data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Versus 10, 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, stock left is 250−8k; next month it's 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Even all 25 leave 50, but recovery to 500 isn't guaranteed; long-run gains aren't assured. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Each person: what exact catch do you intend, and does it depend on others?
